name: knoxnet-browser-cam
description: Mobile-first web app + local Node.js receiver to turn a phone browser into a LAN WebRTC camera for the Knoxnet VMS.

scripts.dev:https: npm run dev:cert && concurrently -k -n receiver,web -c blue,magenta "WSS=true PHONE_APP_SCHEME=https PHONE_APP_PORT=5173 npm run receiver" "npm:web:https"
scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:cert && concurrently -k -n bridge,receiver,web -c green,blue,magenta "npm:bridge" "BRIDGE_URL=http://localhost:8790 WSS=true PHONE_APP_SCHEME=https PHONE_APP_PORT=5173 npm run receiver" "npm:web:https"
scripts.receiver:dev-phone: npm run dev:cert && WSS=true PHONE_APP_SCHEME=https PHONE_APP_PORT=5173 npm run receiver
scripts.deploy:pages: npx wrangler@latest pages deploy web/dist --project-name knoxnet-browser-cam --branch main
scripts.build: npm --workspace web run build && npm --workspace receiver run build && npm --workspace bridge run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace web run typecheck && npm --workspace receiver run typecheck && npm --workspace bridge run typecheck
